project_summary: A TypeScript monorepo with independently testable application and package surfaces that periodically require parallel migration or refactor lanes.
full_gate_command: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
project_rules: Each parallel lane must own an explicit file surface.
The orchestrator owns integration and the repository-wide gate.
do_not_rules: Do not run parallel write lanes in a shared checkout.
Do not commit, push, deploy, or run production migrations.

additional_agents.name: ui-package-implementer
additional_agents.description: Implement an accepted contract inside the shared design system package
instructions: Work only from the accepted spec in .ai/specs/current-task.md.
Stay inside packages/ui. A change needed elsewhere is a finding, not a task.
Run the package's own checks before reporting completion.

graphs.name: cross-package-change
graphs.description: Map the blast radius of a change across packages, then verify the shared contracts.

nodes.prompt: Map every package that consumes the changed module. Report the importing packages, the exported symbols they rely on, and the shared contracts involved. Return evidence with file paths, not file dumps.
Review the change against the cross-package schema and API contracts named in the map. Report only breakages you can point at in a file.
Check that each parallel lane owns a disjoint file surface and that no two lanes write the same file. Report every overlap.
Adversarially verify each reported finding. Try to refute it. Treat a finding you cannot reproduce from the cited files as refuted.
nodes.repeat_until: every finding is either confirmed with a citation or refuted
